description: #328: the refusal of a resume of a run whose run-store head is complete, refused by name before anything of the run is bound: no model request, no tool call and no record write. Both languages emit exactly this error event, once, and then end; Go reports an empty usage between them (go/context/run_writer.go, RunComplete, PrepareDurableInput; go/adapter/completetests). Three resumes of a complete head are kept: a job wait's continuation where the store holds that wait claimed at this head (resumeParked, then the job continuation), a re-authorization claim's (reauthorizedRunStore), and a leg of the run's open objective (#330).

items.message: RunComplete: the run is complete, and a finished run is not resumed. Only a claimed job wait's or a re-authorization's continuation, or a leg of an open objective, resumes it.

failure.detail: RunComplete: the run is complete, and a finished run is not resumed. Only a claimed job wait's or a re-authorization's continuation, or a leg of an open objective, resumes it.
